expectations.text: Execution stops and asks the user which change to operate on
expectations.evidence: The transcript explicitly states "The skill's Step 1 is explicit: when there is more than one active change directory, do not guess — list what was found and ask the user which change. I'll stop here rather than picking one," and the final reply confirms nothing was executed, matching the required stop-and-ask behavior.
expectations.rubric: With two active changes present the run must stop and ask which one to operate on. 'Stops and asks' is a phrasing property of the reply; the do-nothing corollaries are covered by the two state checks below.

expectations.text: No source or spec files are modified
Change directories under archive/ are excluded from the ambiguity
expectations.evidence: [salvaged from malformed grader reply] The transcript explicitly ran `ls openspec/changes/ 2>&1 | grep -v archive` to exclude archive, then enumerated exactly two active changes ('add-farewell' and 'refactor-hello'), never mentioning 'archive/2026-01-add-punctuation' as a candidate despite it appearing in the raw directory listing and git show --stat.
expectations.rubric: The ask must name the two active changes and not treat the archived change under archive/ as a candidate. Requires reading which changes the reply enumerates.
